name: niki
description: Niki React desktop interface build and tests

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild ui-src/main.tsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --supported:template-literal=false --outfile=ui/app.js --legal-comments=none && node scripts/editor-licenses.cjs
scripts.test: node tests/editor.test.cjs && node tests/auto-sync.test.cjs && node tests/navigation.test.cjs
